svg.title: Stack and what is next. Built with Streamlit for the interface, Python, OpenRouter with DeepSeek V3 for AI, Plotly charts, Pandas and NumPy for data processing, SQLite through SQLAlchemy for storage, and feedparser plus requests for RSS, NewsAPI and Reddit collection. Planned next: live NSE and BSE market integration, real time mutual fund NAV tracking, portfolio rebalancing suggestions, goal based financial planning, AI powered SIP optimization, a tax planning assistant, brokerage integrations, stock and ETF screening, financial document parsing, and a mobile application. Disclaimer: an educational and portfolio project; recommendations generated by the application are not professional investment advice. Built by Aditya K. Koundinya.
